name: campus-wifi-monitor
description: Smart Campus Wi-Fi Monitoring & Network Health Dashboard

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run migrate && npm run seed && npm run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @campus/server" "npm run dev -w @campus/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @campus/server && npm run build -w @campus/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared --noEmit && tsc -p apps/server --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit
